newsitem.title: DUBAI: UAE shares end uninspired week in tight range.
newsitem.headline: UAE shares end uninspired week in tight range.

text.p: Shares on the unofficial United Arab Emirates stock market were mostly steady in the week to Thursday, brokers said.
The National Bank of Abu Dhabi (NBAD) 27-share index was little changed at 2,493.46 points from 2,496.28.
Eighteen shares were steady, five moved up and three fell.

The biggest gainer was Al-Ain Al-Ahlia Insurance which continued its rise, adding 20 dirhams to 1,350. The biggest loser was National Bank of Dubai, which slid 25 dirhams to 655. Brokers attributed the fall to a downward adjustment equal to the size of the bank's dividend.
Market leader Etisalat, the UAE's telecommunications company, gained five dirhams to 930 and Abu Dhabi Shipbuilding Company was up three dirhams at 43.
Dubai Islamic Bank shed five dirhams to 185. Most other shares were steady. -- Dubai newsroom +9714-626990
